about.description: Award winning DeSoto's Seafood Kitchen features fresh seafood, chicken, pasta, steak, home style sides, salads and sandwiches. Daily lunch specials include seafood, chicken, country fried and hamburger steak, ham with 12 great homemade sides and fresh baked rolls. Dinner menu features exquisite appetizers, seafood prepared fried, broiled, grilled, blackened, steamed, or Cajun style, plus chicken and pasta dishes and Hawaiian Ribeye steak.
about.elevator_pitch: Award-winning family seafood restaurant in Gulf Shores serving fresh daily specials, Gulf Coast favorites, and voted best lunch and dinner for 14 years running.
about.vibe: Casual family dining establishment with beachside atmosphere. Not too fancy, not too simple. Welcoming and friendly staff.
about.insider_tip: 1 block north of the Gulf of Mexico. When on a wait, add party to wait list. Can have snack at Sassy Bass in parking lot while waiting or get bar drinks outside.

features: multiple preparation styles (fried, broiled, grilled, blackened, steamed, Cajun)
